notes.title: September 9 Update
notes.content:
September 9 Update
1. Revised descriptions for certain achievements
2. Fixed a bug where victory was granted before the boss was fully defeated
3. Daily Challenge achievements for World First and Top 3 rankings will now be calculated after all daily challenges are settled

notes.title: 9月4日更新
notes.content:
1.增加查看30天挑战活动排行榜
2.修复生物在边缘处无法投掷道具的bug
3.限制障碍球最大移动速度

notes.title: August 27 Update
notes.content:
1. Fixed scaling issue with barrier coordinates
2. Added secondary confirmation for editor return

notes.title: Updated on August 25
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug where the achievement “Speed run” could still be obtained even when using items.
2. Added options to enable and disable controller vibration in the settings panel.

notes.title: August 18th Update
notes.content:
Optimized the reward collection mechanism
Fixed the UFO flickering issue

notes.title: Updated on August 17
notes.content:
1. Added a new background music track.
2. Fixed an issue with the background music in the daily challenge.
3. Improved angle and coordinate accuracy at low sensitivity settings.

notes.title: Updated on August 16
notes.content:
1. Daily challenges now support viewing the previous round rankings.
2. Fixed a bug where the ball would sometimes reset its position before landing.

notes.title: August 2 Update
notes.content:
1.Fixed barrier issue
2. Add a small ball skin
3.Add activity reward issuing function

notes.title: July 30th update
notes.content:
1. Fixed barrier on edge bug
2. Add keyboard mode button assist tip
3. Optimize the “last brick” mechanism.

notes.title: July 30th update
notes.content:
1. Modified level 18 and 36
2. Fixed barrier bugs
3. Further strengthened anti-cheating mechanism

notes.title: Updated July 24th
notes.content:
1. Add three ball skins
2. Improve the traction effect of “Last Brick Problem”.
3. Improve the adaptation of handle buttons.

notes.title: Improvements
notes.content:
1. Introduce ball traction mechanism to solve the last brick problem
2. Repair the problem of unresponsive fast-forward button on the handle.
3. Add crown honor for the full-star king

notes.title: 1.1.0.0 major version update
notes.content:
1. Updated levels to 108 (27 new levels).
2. Added 4 new achievements
3. Added 3 new creatures and 2 new bosses.
4. Added new boss music
5. Added “Baffle Coordinate Display” option in settings.

notes.title: 1.0.3 major version update
notes.content:
1. New props - Reverse and Barrier.
2. Added new bricks - Chain Bricks, Direction Bricks.
3. Added new mechanism - One Way Door
4.Updated 9 levels

notes.title: June 19th update
notes.content:
1. Fixed the issue of invalid music replacement in the level editor.
2. Optimize some material mapping
3. Repair the problem that the custom background is not subject to the lightning darkening effect.

notes.title: Updated on June 17th
notes.content:
1. Optimize loading speed
2. Eliminate the initialization trail of the ball

notes.title: June 15 Update
notes.content:
1. Add shadow effect to block and props
2. Add shadow blocking effect for UI interface.
3. Optimize the ball trailing effect

notes.title: June 15 Update
notes.content:
1.Fix memory leak bug
2.Increase smoothness

notes.title: June 14th update
notes.content:
1. Color Egg Block support making certain types of tiles disappear directly.
2. Stone Block support permanent non-display in hidden state
3. Level editor brick rotation accuracy adjusted from 15 degrees to 5 degrees.
3. Fix the problem of sign-in page

notes.title: June 14th update
notes.content:
1. Fixed leaderboard refreshing problem.
2. Modify the input problem inside the game

notes.title: Detailed Improvement
notes.content:
1. Add arm flinging animation to the prize shaker, full of dynamic feeling.
2. Repair some unresponsive problems.

notes.title: Fix bugs
notes.content: 1. Split or pomegranate effects are not allowed for ball drops.

notes.title: Function Update
notes.content:
1. Show opening logo
2. Fixed the bug that split ball props are invalid when magnet effect is applied.

notes.title: Function Improvement
notes.content:
1. Fix the problem that the ball does not launch when the magnet effect ends
2. Optimize the picture quality of the preview image of the mod.

notes.title: Function Improvement
notes.content:
1. Fix the problem that the ball sometimes stays still
2. Try to fix the problem of exiting the game and getting stuck.
3. Optimize the archery mechanism of Terracotta Warriors.

notes.title: Function update
notes.content:
1. The number of leaderboard displays has increased to 300, and the positioning function has been added
2. Display the emission angle

notes.title: Functionality Updates
notes.content:
1. Increase the world leaderboard pass date and optimize the sorting problem.
2.Repair the problem of fluctuating timing of high brush screen.
3.Repair the problem that 72 levels cannot be opened

notes.title: Function update
notes.content:
Function update: 
1. Fully adapt to the xbox controller function 
2. Creative Workshop page set up difficulty label can be filtered 
3. Other details optimization

notes.title: Function Updates
notes.content:
1. Support level editor to continuously drag and drop bricks to enjoy silky smoothness.
2. Add logos for gain and loss props.

notes.title: Function and detail optimization
notes.content:
1. Props are color-coded to distinguish gain and loss effects.
2. Optimize texture quality
3.Fix the bug of uploading the leaderboard of Creative Workshop.

notes.title: Creative Workshop Updates and Other Detailed Optimizations
notes.content:
1.Add the rule that authors can only submit the level after they have passed the level, and it will show the authors' achievements.
2. Mod levels have new difficulty display and star time, and improved preview image.
3. The range of angle of incidence at the beginning of the ball has been enlarged.
4. New gold prizes in the prize machine.
5.Add batch move function to level editor.
6. Author can choose to delete or keep the old leaderboard data when updating levels.

notes.title: Game function update and detail improvement
notes.content:
1. Optimize the physical calculation of the baffle
2. Add setting button to pause interface.
3. Add text hints to the buttons of victory and failure interface.
4. Optimize the mouse sensitivity and block speed adjustment function.
5. After passing the level, the level list will not be forced to jump to the last page.
6. Optimize some animation effects.

notes.title: Fixed some bugs.
notes.content:
1. Fixed the problem of infinite ball bouncing horizontally and vertically.
2. Problems with the use of props in certain scenes.
3. Conflict between the pause interface, help interface and props interface of the game scene.

notes.title: Fix bug
notes.content: Fixed the limitation of the number of characters to be entered in the Mod Profile
